ABA League Game

Source: R/aba.R
aba_game.Rd

Header of one finished game: round, date, venue, attendance, both clubs with their score, commissioner and referees.

Endpoint: GET https://www.aba-liga.com/match/{game_no}/{sez}/{lea}/Overview sez = season - 2001; league = "aba2" reads https://druga.aba-liga.com with lea = 2.

Usage

aba_game(game_no, season, league = "aba")

Arguments

game_no

Required. Game number within the season AND league (it restarts at 1 for every season and league), e.g. 6; game_no in aba_calendar. Playoff games that were not needed leave gaps.

season

Required. Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). the wrapper sends the site's START-year key sez = season - 2001 (25). The ABA League's first season is 2001-02 (season=2002).

league

League: aba (ABA League, www.aba-liga.com, site code lea=1) or aba2 (ABA League 2, druga.aba-liga.com, lea=2). Both sites serve one database; the runtime asks the league's own host. Default "aba".

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row keyed by (game_no, season, league_id): round and competition labels, the date line split into date / time / time_zone (CET is wall-clock Central European time including summer time; ABA League 2 prints local), attendance, venue (null before 2017-18), the two clubs with their global team_id and final score, the commissioner and the referees ("; "-joined, names only). Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sdv-py.

col_nametypedescription
game_nointegerGame number, per season AND league: it restarts at 1 for every season and league, so a game's key is (game_no, season, league_id). Unplayed playoff games leave gaps. The {gameNo} of the match route.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26): the site's START-year key sez (25) plus 2001.
league_idintegerLeague code, the site's lea: 1 = ABA League, 2 = ABA League 2.
leaguecharacterLeague label: aba (ABA League, lea 1) or aba2 (ABA League 2, lea 2), the wrapper's league argument.
season_labelcharacterSeason label as the page prints it ('2025/26' on the match page, 'Season 2025/26' on the calendar and standings pages).
roundcharacterRound / phase label as the page prints it: 'ROUND 1', 'Top8 - R2', 'Quarter-finals, Round 1', 'Finals, Round 4', 'Semifinal'. Same vocabulary as calendar games[].round.
competitioncharacterCompetition name as printed, sponsor included and applied to every season: 'AdmiralBet ABA League' (2017-18 and 2025-26), 'Regional League' (2008-09), '2. ABA liga' (ABA League 2).
groupcharacterGroup letter of a two-group regular season ('A', 'B'). ABSENT when the season has no groups (2008-09, 2017-18 and ABA League 2 samples).
whencharacterDate-and-time line verbatim (English weekday, dd.mm.yyyy, hh:mm, time-zone label).
dateDateGame date, from the date-and-time line (the first date of a window); null for 'TBA'.
date_toDateLast date of a 'dd.mm.yyyy - dd.mm.yyyy' window printed before a game is scheduled; null on a game with a single date.
timecharacterTip-off time 'hh:mm' in time_zone.
time_zonecharacter'CET' = Central European wall-clock time INCLUDING summer time (the label never changes; the Dubai local times prove CEST in October/June, CET in winter); 'local' = the arena's local time (ABA League 2 prints 'Local time').
local_timecharacterArena-local tip-off 'hh:mm' when the arena is outside Central Europe ('(19:00 Dubai local time)'); null otherwise.
local_placecharacterCity of local_time ('Dubai', 'Cluj-Napoca'); null when the arena is in Central Europe.
attendanceintegerSpectators (the users icon). The parser sets null when the page prints none (never seen: every banked page prints it; null is part of the record contract).
venuecharacterArena name ('Venue: ...'). ABSENT on the 2008-09 sample (the page has no venue line).
home_team_idintegerABA team id (key space: aba-liga.com clubs, the same id in every season and in both leagues, e.g. Partizan = 22 in 2008-09 and 2025-26, Krka = 10). The first number of /team/{id}/{sez}/{lea}/0/{slug}/ and of the logo images/club/{size}/{id}.png. Joins match game.*_team_id / players / teams / pbp, standings rows and the player page. Not a player id.
home_teamcharacterHome club name as the site prints it NOW: a club's current name is applied to every season (2008-09 shows 'Partizan Mozzart Bet'); a club that no longer plays keeps its last name (2008-09 'Petrol Olimpija'). Join on the team id.
home_citycharacterHome club city (local spelling: 'Beograd', 'Novo Mesto').
home_scoreintegerHome final score.
away_team_idintegerABA team id (key space: aba-liga.com clubs, the same id in every season and in both leagues, e.g. Partizan = 22 in 2008-09 and 2025-26, Krka = 10). The first number of /team/{id}/{sez}/{lea}/0/{slug}/ and of the logo images/club/{size}/{id}.png. Joins match game.*_team_id / players / teams / pbp, standings rows and the player page. Not a player id.
away_teamcharacterAway club name as the site prints it now (see home_team).
away_citycharacterAway club city (local spelling).
away_scoreintegerAway final score.
commissionercharacterGame commissioner's name ('Commissioner:' line); 2008-09 adds an IOC-style country code in parentheses ('(SRB)'). Null when not printed.
refereescharacterReferees' names in page order (crew chief first), joined with '; ' (2008-09 adds an IOC-style country code in parentheses). Names only.

Details

Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read the leagues' own PHP sites (www.aba-liga.com, druga.aba-liga.com), keyless, with no bot wall; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. www.aba-liga.com/robots.txt is the single line User-agent: * (nothing disallowed, no Crawl-delay) and druga has no robots.txt; no terms page was found. The runtime waits at least 1 s per host before every request.

Coverage: box scores from 2001-02; play-by-play, the starter and on-court markers, the shot chart and the minute-by-minute score from 2017-18 (earlier games answer an empty pbp and hoopR_no_data for the helpers). A game is keyed by (game_no, season, league_id): game_no restarts at 1 for every season and league. Team and player ids are global; the calendar carries club names only. Club names are the club's CURRENT name on every season: join on team_id.

Only finished games are served: an unplayed game, or one whose period scores, team totals or play-by-play do not add up to the final score, raises hoopR_asset_fetch, as does a page for another game, season or league than asked. The three live-match helpers echo nothing about the game, so the runtime fetches the same game's match page first (one extra request) and checks the helper against it.

Times: CET means Central European wall-clock time including summer time (the label never changes); ABA League 2 prints Local time. Officials appear by name only; the player bio (birth date and place, nationality) is the public player profile.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when the site has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game redirected to /match-not-defined/, a season the site does not hold or before 2001-02, a live-match helper with no data before 2017-18); hoopR_bad_request for an invalid argument (a non-integer id or season, a league other than aba / aba2) or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed (any other non-200, a connection failure after three attempts, a redirect off the ABA sites) or the answer is not the one asked for (a page for another game, season or league, an unfinished game, a helper that does not belong to the game, layout drift). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

Other ABA: aba_box_players(), aba_box_teams(), aba_calendar(), aba_pbp(), aba_periods(), aba_player(), aba_player_games(), aba_score_difference(), aba_score_flow(), aba_shots(), aba_standings()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(aba_game(game_no = 6, season = 2026))
#> ── ABA League Game ───────────────────────────────────────── hoopR 3.1.0.9000 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 15:32:24 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 27
#>   game_no season league_id league season_label round   competition   group when 
#>     <int>  <int>     <int> <chr>  <chr>        <chr>   <chr>         <chr> <chr>
#> 1       6   2026         1 aba    2025/26      ROUND 1 AdmiralBet A… B     Sund…
#> # ℹ 18 more variables: date <date>, date_to <date>, time <chr>,
#> #   time_zone <chr>, local_time <chr>, local_place <chr>, attendance <int>,
#> #   venue <chr>, home_team_id <int>, home_team <chr>, home_city <chr>,
#> #   home_score <int>, away_team_id <int>, away_team <chr>, away_city <chr>,
#> #   away_score <int>, commissioner <chr>, referees <chr>
# }
